name: Hungarian Grand Prix
sources_2026_10_03: formula1.com, FIA, McLaren, Cadillac; 2026-07-26. Verified 2026-10-03 against the FIA final classification, final starting grid and qualifying classification: onRoadPos added for Hamilton (4) and Bearman (17); Leclerc fastest lap 1:22.000 confirmed.
summary: Lando Norris took his and McLaren's first Grand Prix win of 2026 at the Hungarian Grand Prix, beating Max Verstappen by 15.080s, with Kimi Antonelli third at +18.728s. Norris lost the lead to team mate Oscar Piastri at Turn 2 on lap one, then regained the effective lead through pace and strategy after Piastri's contact with Sainz and a late gearbox failure. Piastri's lap-56 retirement caused a VSC; Norris pitted for Softs while Verstappen and Antonelli stayed out to take second and third. Three cars retired: Piastri, Sergio Perez and Valtteri Bottas, and Hamilton's five-second pit-lane penalty and Bearman's five-second blue-flag penalty remained in the result.
